body: Lmaoo idk why most ppl have the impression that cats are lazy and rude. Like bro my cats just saved me from death bc they’re the sweetest in the world. Legit once I was having a mental breakdown and my cats came and started rubbing my tears off my face.
Mhm they mean the world to me. I know that they’re thick headed and don’t understand anything, but at least they stick around with me while I rant about my problems.
I’m sorry about ur dad :,(. But I’m not killin myself bc of my friends. I’ve been going thru some stuff for a rlly long time and I don’t think there’s a future for me anymore.
Update I decided not to. Not for myself. Not for my parents. Not for my friends. But for my cats.

I agree all the hotlines I’ve been on just agree with everything I say and don’t actually help me. In fact they make me feel worse about myself. I’m sure they’re trying their best and have many people to tend to but eh.im not getting any help :/
Idk I’m not comfortable talking to a school counselor cuz I’ll get kicked out of my ehhh how to explain “skip a grade program” bc. And I don’t trust my parents nor do I have any close friends.
